While the Oka Sho where Sweep Tosho ran 
her heart out certainly generated 
excitement, it couldn't change the fact 
that the Classic Triple Crown drew far 
more attention.

A few days later, at an interview 
gathering Umamusume from the Triple Tiara 
route, Sweep Tosho declared that she was 
going to change all the boring common 
sense.

First blaze through the Triple Tiara, and 
once reaching the Senior Class, defeat the 
girls from the Triple Crown route and 
rewrite history.

Her next goal is the second leg of the 
Triple Tiara route, the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks). A fierce battle to crown the Queen 
of the Oaks awaits the little witch.
